div.l: Schort was his gowne . with sleues long ⁊and wyde .
Well couthe he sitte on hors . ⁊and fayre ride .
He couthe songes make . ⁊and well endyte .
Iust ⁊and eke daunce . ⁊and well portroie ⁊and wryte .
So hote he loued . that bi nyghter tale .
He slepe no more . than doth a nyghtyngale .
Curteis he was . lowely ⁊and seruysable .
And carf bi fore his Fadir . atte table .
A yeman had he . ⁊and seruauntes no mo .
At that tyme . for hym lust to ride so .
And he was clad . in coote ⁊and hood of grene .
A scheef of pecok arwes . bright ⁊and kene .
Vndir his belte . he bar full thriftyly .
Well couthe he dresse . his takell yemanly .
His arowes drouped nought . with feþeris lowe .
And in his honde . he bare a myghty bowe .
A not heed had he . with a broıı̄un visage .
Of wode craft . well couthe he all the vsage
Vp on his arme . he bare a gaye bracer .
And bi his side . a swerd ⁊and a bokeler .
And on that other side . a gaye daggere .
Harneisid well . ⁊and scharpe as poynt of spere .
A xpofre on his brest . of siluer schene .
An horn he bar . the baudrik was of grene .
A foster was he . sothely as I gesse .
Ther was also . a Nonne a prioresse .
That of hir smylyng . was full symple ⁊and coy .
Here grettist othe . was but bi seynt Loy .
And sche was clepid / ma dame Eglentyne .
Full well sche song . the seruyce deuyne .
Entuned in hir nose . full semely
And frensch sche spak . full faire ⁊and fetisly .
After the scole . of Stratford atte bowe .
For frensch of Paris . was to hir vnknowe .
At mete well taught . was sche with all
Sche let no morsell . fro hir lippes fall .
Sche ne wette hir / fyngers . in hir sauce depe .
Well couthe sche carie a morsell . ⁊and well kepe .
That no drope . ne fill vp on hir breste .
In curtesie was sette . full moche hir leste .
Hir oủerlippe . wyped sche so clene .
That in hir cuppe . ther was no ferthyng sene .
Of grece . whan sche droūnken had hir draught .
Full semely . after hir mete sche raught .
And sikerly . sche was . of gret disporte .
And full plesaūnt . ⁊and amyable of porte .
And peyned hir . to coūntirfete chere . /
